criterion: which domain of assistant functionality the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Alarms
categories.definition: Setting, managing, or querying alarms intended to wake the user or signal a specific time of day.

categories.name: Reminders
categories.definition: Creating, deleting, or reviewing tasks or notifications intended to remind the user to perform an action.

categories.name: Messaging
categories.definition: Sending, reading, or managing text messages, video messages, or other written correspondence to contacts.

categories.name: Calling
categories.definition: Initiating, managing, or ending voice or video calls with contacts or groups.

categories.name: Weather
categories.definition: Querying current conditions, forecasts, or specific weather parameters like temperature and precipitation.

categories.name: Music & Audio
categories.definition: Playing, controlling, or identifying music, songs, artists, or audio stations.

categories.name: Timers
categories.definition: Setting, adjusting, or checking countdown timers for durations of time.

categories.name: Contacts & Social
categories.definition: Retrieving information about contacts, relationships, employment history, or social connections.

categories.name: News
categories.definition: Requesting news headlines, stories, or updates on current events.

categories.name: Food & Recipes
categories.definition: Requesting recipes, cooking instructions, or nutritional information for food and drink.

categories.name: Events & Activities
categories.definition: Finding local events, activities, or things to do in specific locations.

categories.name: Availability & Status
categories.definition: Checking the online status or availability of contacts, or setting the user's own status.

categories.name: General Knowledge
categories.definition: Answering factual questions or providing information not covered by other specific domains.
